source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Install full memory
2. Check memory information in BIOS
3. Check memory information in OS

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Memory size, speed and slot should be correct in BIOS
2. Memory size, speed and slot should be correct in OS

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- RDIMM: install full memory population and confirm memory size/speed/slot show correctly in BIOS and OS. Agent can read the OS-side memory sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "sudo dmidecode -t memory 2>&1 | grep -Ei 'Size|Speed|Locator|Part Number' | head -n 60; lsmem 2>&1" ; installing the full population is physical and the BIOS view is operator-read.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return dmidecode Size/Speed/Locator + lsmem so the operator confirms memory config is correct in OS and BIOS.

original_test_intent: Validate a fully populated RDIMM configuration against the approved slot recipe, with correct size, speed and slot mapping independently demonstrated in BIOS and OS.
original_method: An ESD-qualified operator powers down and installs every RDIMM, records the BIOS memory page, then automation collects complete Type17, lsmem and memory-health evidence and compares each populated slot after approved boot.
manual_activity: An operator must safely install the full RDIMM population and observe/record the BIOS size, speed and slot display; the OS inventory and comparison stage is automated.
required_inputs: Supported RDIMM part/rank/capacity/speed population and slot map
Approved maintenance, boot and OOB recovery plan
safety_requirements: Physical DIMM work requires power isolation, ESD control and the vendor population procedure.
Do not infer BIOS correctness from OS inventory or automate DIMM reseating/swapping.
Collect complete Type17 records; do not truncate the population with head.
Stop on training/boot failure, ECC/EDAC error, thermal issue or capacity mismatch; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: After operator handoff, collect complete Type17/lsmem/kernel-EDAC evidence, map every slot to the approved recipe and flag size/speed/identity/health discrepancies.
Keep BIOS observation and OS result distinct and prepare evidence without issuing the formal verdict.
engineer_actions: Perform/attest safe full RDIMM installation and BIOS observation.
Approve recipe and power transition, reconcile BIOS/OS findings and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: dmidecode and lsmem are relevant, but grep plus head -n 60 can omit DIMMs and lacks configured speed, full identity and ECC/EDAC health.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive full dmidecode Type17, byte-accurate lsmem, kernel/EDAC health and slot-by-slot comparison without truncation.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The full-population scope and 15/15-minute values remain; physical installation and BIOS viewing remain manual.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind operator installation and BIOS screenshots to a slot recipe, then generate a complete non-truncated OS topology/health comparison for every socket/channel/slot.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record platform, BIOS/BMC, DIMM FRU/revision, dmidecode and kernel versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform memory-population and DIMM service documentation plus applicable SMBIOS Type17 definitions.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds explicit slot-to-part mapping, full untruncated OS evidence and separate BIOS/OS results.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects omitted slots, mixed parts/ranks, configured-speed differences and ECC/training faults that a short grep can miss.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Approved full-population recipe and BIOS/OS baselines.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: OS data cannot substitute for direct BIOS observation; SMBIOS locators must be mapped to physical silkscreen names.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve a specific full-population recipe and evidence tools, but completion covers only that approved topology and cannot claim unsupported DIMM combinations.
expected_evidence: Approved population/slot recipe and physical installation record
BIOS photos/worksheet for every slot, size and speed
Complete Type17 and lsmem evidence with slot mapping
Separated BIOS and OS comparisons plus recovery record

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, procedure and criteria consistently require physical full population plus BIOS and OS checks.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The manual setup and BIOS observation make the case partial, not blocked; the automated OS core can proceed after operator handoff.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains the correct partial boundary but removes evidence truncation and BIOS-from-OS inference.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Keeps its safe attended workflow and complete evidence model.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Uses the formal PARTIAL JSON label and separates automated execution status from engineer verdict.

review_improvement: Makes every populated slot auditable and prevents an incomplete OS excerpt from being treated as proof of full BIOS/OS topology correctness.
independent_technical_reasoning: Full memory population is a physical topology assertion; it requires physical and BIOS attestation plus complete slot-resolved OS evidence, so neither the manual nor automated half can stand in for the other.
